                div.addEventListener('dragstart', handleDragStart);
                div.addEventListener('dragend', handleDragEnd);
                div.addEventListener('dragover', handleDragOver);
                div.addEventListener('drop', handleDrop);
                div.addEventListener('dragleave', handleDragLeave);

                container.appendChild(div);
            });
        }

        // 创建筒子圆点
        function createDots(count) {
            let dots = '';
            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                dots += '<div class="dot"></div>';
            }
            return dots;
        }

        // 创建条子竹节
        function createBamboo(count) {
            let bamboo = '';
            if (count === 1) {
                bamboo = '<div class="bamboo-stick"></div>';
            } else if (count === 2) {
                bamboo = '<div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div>';
            } else if (count === 3) {
                bamboo = '<div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div>';
            } else if (count === 4) {
                bamboo = '<div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div>';
            } else if (count === 5) {
                bamboo = '<div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div>';
            } else if (count === 6) {
                bamboo = '<div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div>';
            } else if (count === 7) {
                bamboo = '<div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div>';
            } else if (count === 8) {
                bamboo = '<div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div>';
            } else if (count === 9) {
                bamboo = '<div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div>';
            }
            return bamboo;
        }

        // 拖拽相关变量
        let draggedCardId = null;

        function handleDragStart(e) {
            draggedCardId = e.target.dataset.cardId;
            e.target.classList.add('dragging');
            e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
        }

        function handleDragEnd(e) {
            e.target.classList.remove('dragging');
            document.querySelectorAll('.card').forEach(card => {
                card.classList.remove('drag-over');
            });
            draggedCardId = null;
        }

        function handleDragOver(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
            const target = e.target.closest('.card');
            if (target && target.dataset.cardId !== draggedCardId) {
                target.classList.add('drag-over');
            }
        }

        function handleDragLeave(e) {
            const target = e.target.closest('.card');
            if (target) {
                target.classList.remove('drag-over');
            }
        }

        function handleDrop(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const target = e.target.closest('.card');
            if (!target || !draggedCardId) return;

            const targetCardId = target.dataset.cardId;
            if (targetCardId === draggedCardId) return;

            // 重新排序手牌
            const fromIndex = gameState.myHand.findIndex(c => c.id === draggedCardId);
            const toIndex = gameState.myHand.findIndex(c => c.id === targetCardId);

            if (fromIndex !== -1 && toIndex !== -1) {
                const [movedCard] = gameState.myHand.splice(fromIndex, 1);
                gameState.myHand.splice(toIndex, 0, movedCard);
                renderMyHand();
            }

            target.classList.remove('drag-over');
        }

        // 判断是否是万能牌
        function isWildCard(card) {
            if (!gameState || !gameState.wildCard) return false;
            const wild = gameState.wildCard;

            if (card.suit === wild.suit && card.rank === wild.rank) return true;
            if (card.type === 'arrow' && card.rank === '中') return true;

            return false;
        }

        // 获取牌的短名称
        function getCardShortName(card) {
            if (card.type === 'number') {
                return card.rank;
            } else {
                return card.rank;
            }
        }

        // 获取牌的显示名称
        function getCardDisplayName(card) {
            if (card.type === 'number') {
                return `${card.rank}${card.suit}`;
            } else if (card.type === 'wind') {
                return card.rank;
            } else {
                return card.rank;
            }
        }

        // 选择牌
        function selectCard(card) {
            if (selectedCard && selectedCard.id === card.id) {
                selectedCard = null;
            } else {
                selectedCard = card;
            }

            // 如果是自己回合且有选中的牌，启用出牌按钮
            const isMyTurn = gameState && gameState.currentPlayer === myIndex;
            document.getElementById('playBtn').disabled = !isMyTurn || !selectedCard;

            renderMyHand();
        }

        // 出牌
        function playCard() {
            if (!selectedCard) return;

            ws.send(JSON.stringify({
                type: 'play',
                cardId: selectedCard.id
            }));

            selectedCard = null;
        }

        // 换发
        // 换發
        function changeFa() {
            ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'changeFa' }));
        }

        // 暗杠
        function doGang() {
            if (selectedCard) {
                ws.send(JSON.stringify({
                    type: 'gang',
                    cardId: selectedCard.id
                }));
            }
        }

        // 胡牌
        function declareHu() {
            ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'hu' }));
        }

        // 聊天
        function sendChat() {
            const input = document.getElementById('chatInput');
            const text = input.value.trim();
            if (text) {
                ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'chat', text }));
                input.value = '';
            }
        }

        function handleChatKey(event) {
            if (event.key === 'Enter') {
                sendChat();
            }
        }

        // 添加聊天消息
        function addChatMessage(text) {
            const container = document.getElementById('chatMessages');
            const div = document.createElement('div');
            div.textContent = text;
            div.style.marginBottom = '5px';
            container.appendChild(div);
            container.scrollTop = container.scrollHeight;
        }

        // 初始化
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            connect();
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

```javascript
function isWildCard(card) {
    if (!gameState || !gameState.wildCard) return false;
```

这个逻辑是：
1. 如果牌的花色和点数与万能牌相同，则是万能牌
2. 如果牌是"中"，则是万能牌

但是桐城麻将的规则是：
- 和翻出的牌相同的牌是万能牌
- 红中也是万能牌

这个逻辑看起来是对的。但问题可能是：
- 比较时用的是 `card.rank === wild.rank`，如果 `wild.rank` 是数字而 `card.rank` 也是数字，应该没问题
- 但如果是风牌或箭牌，`rank` 是字符串

    <script>
        // 全局变量
        let ws = null;
        let playerId = null;
        let playerName = '';
        let currentTableId = null;
        let selectedCard = null;
        let gameState = null;
        let myIndex = 0;
        let isReady = false;

        // 连接WebSocket
        function connect() {
            const protocol = window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:';
            ws = new WebSocket(`${protocol}//${window.location.host}`);

            ws.onopen = () => {
                console.log('WebSocket已连接');
            };

            ws.onmessage = (event) => {
                const data = JSON.parse(event.data);
                handleMessage(data);
            };

            ws.onclose = () => {
                console.log('WebSocket已断开');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    if (playerId) {
                        connect();
                    }
                }, 3000);
            };

            ws.onerror = (error) => {
                console.error('WebSocket错误:', error);
            };
        }

        // 处理消息
        function handleMessage(data) {
            switch (data.type) {
                case 'loginSuccess':
                    playerId = data.playerId;
                    playerName = data.playerName;
                    document.getElementById('loginForm').classList.add('hidden');
                    document.getElementById('playerInfo').classList.remove('hidden');
                    document.getElementById('myName').textContent = playerName;
                    document.getElementById('tableListContainer').classList.remove('hidden');
                    break;

                case 'tableList':
                    renderTableList(data.tables);
                    break;

                case 'playerList':
                    renderPlayerList(data);
                    break;

                case 'dealStart':
                    // 开始发牌动画
                    showDealAnimation();
                    break;

                case 'gameState':
                    gameState = data.data;
                    myIndex = gameState.myIndex;
                    console.log('收到游戏状态:', gameState);
                    console.log('我的手牌:', gameState.myHand);
                    console.log('手牌数量:', gameState.myHand ? gameState.myHand.length : 0);
                    updateGameUI();
                    break;

                case 'message':
                    addChatMessage(data.text);
                    break;

                case 'error':
                    alert(data.message);
                    break;
            }
        }

        // 登录
        function login() {
            const name = document.getElementById('playerName').value.trim();
            if (!name) {
                alert('请输入名字');
                return;
            }

            playerName = name;
            if (!ws || ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) {
                connect();
                setTimeout(() => {
                    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'login', name }));
                }, 500);
            } else {
                ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'login', name }));
            }
        }

        // 退出
        function logout() {
            if (currentTableId) {
                leaveTable();
            }
            playerId = null;
            playerName = '';
            document.getElementById('loginForm').classList.remove('hidden');
            document.getElementById('playerInfo').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('tableListContainer').classList.add('hidden');
        }

        // 渲染牌桌列表
        function renderTableList(tables) {
            const container = document.getElementById('tableList');
            container.innerHTML = '';

            // 创建新桌卡片
            const createCard = document.createElement('div');
            createCard.className = 'table-card create-table-card';
            createCard.innerHTML = `
                <div class="plus">+</div>
                <div class="text">开房</div>
            `;
            createCard.onclick = createTable;
            container.appendChild(createCard);

            // 现有牌桌
            tables.forEach((table, index) => {
                const card = document.createElement('div');
                const isFull = table.playerCount >= 4;
                const isPlaying = table.started;

                card.className = `table-card ${isFull ? 'full' : ''} ${isPlaying ? 'playing' : ''}`;

                // 生成圆桌座位显示
                let seatsHtml = '';
                for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                    const seatNum = i + 1;
                    const player = table.players.find(p => p.seatNum === seatNum);
                    const occupied = !!player;
                    const occupiedClass = occupied ? 'occupied' : '';
                    const clickHandler = (!occupied && !isPlaying) ? `onclick="event.stopPropagation(); joinTableById('${table.id}', ${seatNum})"` : '';
                    const title = occupied && player ? player.name : (isPlaying ? '' : '点击加入');
                    const displayChar = occupied ? (player ? player.name.charAt(0) : '?') : '+';

                    seatsHtml += `
                        <div class="mini-seat mini-seat-${seatNum}">
                            <div class="mini-seat-avatar ${occupiedClass}" ${clickHandler} title="${title}">
                                ${displayChar}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    `;
                }

                // 状态文字
                let statusText = `${table.playerCount}/4 人`;
                let statusClass = '';
                if (isPlaying) {
                    statusText = '🀄 游戏中';
                    statusClass = 'playing';
                } else if (isFull) {
                    statusText = '已满员';
                    statusClass = 'full';
                }

                card.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="table-header">
                        <div class="table-id">牌桌：${table.tableNumber}</div>
                        <div class="table-mode-badge">${isPlaying ? '游戏中' : '等待中'}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="mini-table-layout">
                        <div class="mini-table-center">🀄</div>
                        ${seatsHtml}
                    </div>
                    <div class="table-footer ${statusClass}">${statusText}</div>
                `;

                // 点击整个卡片也可以加入（如果未满且未开始）
                if (!isFull && !isPlaying) {
                    card.onclick = () => joinTableById(table.id);
                }

                container.appendChild(card);
            });
        }

        // 通过ID加入牌桌
        function joinTableById(tableId, seatNum = null) {
            if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
                ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'joinTable', tableId: tableId, seatNum: seatNum }));
                currentTableId = tableId;
            }
        }

        // 创建牌桌（原有函数保留）
        function createTable() {
            if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
                ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'createTable' }));
            }
        }

        function joinTable(tableId, seatNum = null) {
            if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
                ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'joinTable', tableId, seatNum }));

            }

        // 创建牌桌
        function createTable() {

            }
        }

        function joinTable(tableId, seatNum = null) {

                ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'joinTable', tableId, seatNum }));
                currentTableId = tableId;
            }
        }

        // 离开牌桌
        function leaveTable() {
            showLobby();
            currentTableId = null;
            isReady = false;
        }

        // 显示大厅
        function showLobby() {
            document.getElementById('lobby').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('gameContainer').style.display = 'none';
            if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
                ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'getTableList' }));
            }
        }

        // 显示游戏界面
        function showGame() {
            document.getElementById('lobby').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('gameContainer').style.display = 'block';
        }

        // 渲染玩家列表
        function renderPlayerList(data) {
            showGame();

            document.getElementById('tableNumDisplay').textContent = data.tableNumber;

            // 更新准备面板
            const seatList = document.getElementById('seatList');
            seatList.innerHTML = '';

            const players = data.players || [];
            for (let i = 1; i <= 4; i++) {
                const player = players.find(p => p.seatNum === i);
                const div = document.createElement('div');
                div.className = 'seat-item';

                if (player) {
                    div.classList.add('occupied');
                    if (player.id === playerId) {
                        div.classList.add('me');
                    }
                    div.innerHTML = `
                        <div><strong>${i}号位</strong></div>
                        <div>${player.name} ${player.ready ? '✓已准备' : ''}</div>
                    `;
                } else {
                    div.innerHTML = `
                        <div><strong>${i}号位</strong></div>
                        <div>空位</div>
                    `;
                }
                seatList.appendChild(div);
            }

            // 游戏已开始，隐藏准备面板
            if (data.started) {
                document.getElementById('readyPanel').classList.add('hidden');
            } else {
                document.getElementById('readyPanel').classList.remove('hidden');
            }

            // 更新准备按钮
            const myPlayer = players.find(p => p.id === playerId);
            isReady = myPlayer ? myPlayer.ready : false;
            document.getElementById('readyBtn').textContent = isReady ? '取消准备' : '准备';
        }

        // 切换准备状态
        function toggleReady() {
            isReady = !isReady;
            ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'ready', ready: isReady }));
        }

        // 发牌动画
        function showDealAnimation() {
            const dealAnimation = document.getElementById('dealAnimation');
            const dealPiles = document.getElementById('dealPiles');
            const dealInfo = document.getElementById('dealInfo');
            const dealProgress = document.getElementById('dealProgress');

            dealAnimation.classList.remove('hidden');
            dealPiles.innerHTML = '';

            // 创建四堆牌（每堆17张，两层）
            for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                const pile = document.createElement('div');
                pile.className = 'deal-pile';
                pile.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="deal-pile-label">${i + 1}号位</div>
                    <div class="deal-pile-cards" id="pile${i}"></div>
                `;
                dealPiles.appendChild(pile);
            }

            // 动画展示牌堆
            dealInfo.textContent = '展示牌堆...';
            let cardIndex = 0;
            const totalCards = 68; // 4人 × 17张

            const addCard = setInterval(() => {
                if (cardIndex >= totalCards) {
                    clearInterval(addCard);
                    dealInfo.textContent = '发牌中...';
                    // 开始发牌动画
                    startDealing();
                    return;
                }

                const pileIndex = cardIndex % 4;
                const pile = document.getElementById(`pile${pileIndex}`);
                if (pile) {
                    const card = document.createElement('div');
                    card.className = 'deal-card-back';
                    pile.appendChild(card);
                }

                cardIndex++;
                dealProgress.textContent = `${cardIndex} / ${totalCards}`;
            }, 30);
        }

        // 发牌动画
        function startDealing() {
            const dealInfo = document.getElementById('dealInfo');
            const dealProgress = document.getElementById('dealProgress');

            let round = 0;
            let player = 0;
            let cardInRound = 0;
            const totalRounds = 4; // 4轮发牌

            const dealCard = setInterval(() => {
                if (round >= totalRounds) {
                    clearInterval(dealCard);
                    dealInfo.textContent = '发牌完成！';
                    // 隐藏发牌动画，显示游戏界面
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        document.getElementById('dealAnimation').classList.add('hidden');
                    }, 500);
                    return;
                }

                // 从牌堆移除一张牌
                const piles = document.querySelectorAll('.deal-pile-cards');
                for (let p of piles) {
                    if (p.lastChild) {
                        p.removeChild(p.lastChild);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                cardInRound++;
                if (cardInRound >= 4) {
                    cardInRound = 0;
                    round++;
                }

                dealProgress.textContent = `第 ${round + 1} 轮`;
            }, 100);
        }

        // 更新游戏UI
        function updateGameUI() {
            if (!gameState) return;

            // 游戏开始后隐藏准备面板和发牌动画
            if (gameState.started) {
                document.getElementById('readyPanel').classList.add('hidden');
                document.getElementById('dealAnimation').classList.add('hidden');
            }

            // 更新万能牌
            if (gameState.wildCard) {
                document.getElementById('wildCardDisplay').textContent =
                    getCardDisplayName(gameState.wildCard);
            }

            // 更新牌堆数量
            document.getElementById('deckCount').textContent = gameState.deckCount;

            // 更新游戏时间
            if (gameState.totalGameTime !== undefined) {
                const minutes = Math.floor(gameState.totalGameTime / 60);
                const seconds = gameState.totalGameTime % 60;
                document.getElementById('gameTime').textContent =
                    `${minutes.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${seconds.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
            }

            // 更新各玩家信息
            // 先找到自己的座位号
            let mySeatNum = 1;
            for (const [pid, info] of Object.entries(gameState.playerInfo)) {
                if (pid === Object.keys(gameState.playerInfo)[myIndex]) {
                    mySeatNum = info.seatNum;
                    break;
                }
            }

            console.log('我的座位号:', mySeatNum);

            // 根据座位号计算显示位置
            // position: 0=bottom(自己), 1=right, 2=top, 3=left
            for (let seatNum = 1; seatNum <= 4; seatNum++) {
                // 计算相对位置
                let relativePos = (seatNum - mySeatNum + 4) % 4;

                // 映射到UI位置: 0->1(bottom), 1->2(right), 2->3(top), 3->4(left)
                const posNames = ['player1', 'player2', 'player3', 'player4'];
                const posName = posNames[relativePos];

                console.log(`座位${seatNum} -> 相对位置${relativePos} -> UI元素${posName}`);

                // 找到这个座位的玩家
                let foundPlayer = null;
                for (const [pid, info] of Object.entries(gameState.playerInfo)) {
                    if (info.seatNum === seatNum) {
                        foundPlayer = info;
                        break;
                    }
                }

                const nameEl = document.getElementById(`${posName}Name`);
                const countEl = document.getElementById(`${posName}Count`);
                const infoEl = document.getElementById(`${posName}Info`);

                        nameEl.classList.remove('current-turn');

                    // 展示区

                    if (foundPlayer.showedCards) {

            const isMyTurn = gameState.currentPlayer === myIndex;
            document.getElementById('playBtn').disabled = !isMyTurn || !selectedCard;
            document.getElementById('faBtn').disabled = !gameState.canChangeFa;
            document.getElementById('gangBtn').disabled = !gameState.canGang;

        // 渲染自己的手牌
        function renderMyHand() {

                if (isWild) {

                // 根据牌类型渲染不同样式
                if (card.type === 'number') {
                    if (card.suit === '筒') {

                        div.innerHTML = `<div class="card-face"><div class="dot-container">${createDots(card.rank)}</div></div>`;
                    } else if (card.suit === '条') {
                        div.classList.add('tiao');
                        div.innerHTML = `<div class="card-face"><div class="bamboo-container">${createBamboo(card.rank)}</div></div>`;
                    } else if (card.suit === '万') {
                        div.classList.add('wan');
                        div.innerHTML = `<div class="card-face"><div class="wan-num">${card.rank}</div><div class="wan-char">万</div></div>`;

                    div.classList.add('feng');
                    div.innerHTML = `<div class="card-face"><div class="feng-char">${card.rank}</div></div>`;
                } else if (card.type === 'arrow') {
                    div.classList.add('jian');
                    if (card.rank === '中') div.classList.add('zhong');
                    if (card.rank === '发') div.classList.add('fa');
                    if (card.rank === '白') div.classList.add('bai');
                    div.innerHTML = `<div class="card-face"><div class="jian-char">${card.rank}</div></div>`;
                }

                // 选中状态
                if (selectedCard && selectedCard.id === card.id) {
                    div.classList.add('selected');

                div.onclick = () => selectCard(card);
                div.dataset.cardId = card.id;

                // 拖拽功能
                div.draggable = true;
                div.addEventListener('dragstart', handleDragStart);
                div.addEventListener('dragend', handleDragEnd);
                div.addEventListener('dragover', handleDragOver);

                container.appendChild(div);

        function createDots(count) {

        function createBamboo(count) {

                bamboo = '<div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div>';

            }

        // 拖拽相关变量
        let draggedCardId = null;

        function handleDragStart(e) {
            draggedCardId = e.target.dataset.cardId;

        }

        function handleDragEnd(e) {
            e.target.classList.remove('dragging');
            document.querySelectorAll('.card').forEach(card => {
                card.classList.remove('drag-over');
            });
            draggedCardId = null;
        }

        function handleDragOver(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
            const target = e.target.closest('.card');
            if (target && target.dataset.cardId !== draggedCardId) {
                target.classList.add('drag-over');
            }
        }

        function handleDragLeave(e) {
            const target = e.target.closest('.card');
            if (target) {
                target.classList.remove('drag-over');

        function handleDrop(e) {
            e.preventDefault();

            if (!target || !draggedCardId) return;

            const targetCardId = target.dataset.cardId;
            if (targetCardId === draggedCardId) return;

            // 重新排序手牌
            const fromIndex = gameState.myHand.findIndex(c => c.id === draggedCardId);
            const toIndex = gameState.myHand.findIndex(c => c.id === targetCardId);

            if (fromIndex !== -1 && toIndex !== -1) {
                const [movedCard] = gameState.myHand.splice(fromIndex, 1);
                gameState.myHand.splice(toIndex, 0, movedCard);
                renderMyHand();
            }

            target.classList.remove('drag-over');

        function isWildCard(card) {

            if (card.suit === wild.suit && card.rank === wild.rank) return true;

        // 获取牌的显示名称
        function getCardDisplayName(card) {
            if (card.type === 'number') {
                return `${card.rank}${card.suit}`;
            } else if (card.type === 'wind') {
                return card.rank;
            } else {
                return card.rank;
            }
        }

        // 选择牌
        function selectCard(card) {
            if (selectedCard && selectedCard.id === card.id) {
                selectedCard = null;
            } else {
                selectedCard = card;
            }

            // 如果是自己回合且有选中的牌，启用出牌按钮
            const isMyTurn = gameState && gameState.currentPlayer === myIndex;
            document.getElementById('playBtn').disabled = !isMyTurn || !selectedCard;

            renderMyHand();
        }

        // 出牌
        function playCard() {
            if (!selectedCard) return;

            ws.send(JSON.stringify({
                type: 'play',
                cardId: selectedCard.id
            }));

            selectedCard = null;
        }

        // 换发

        function changeFa() {

        }

        // 暗杠
        function doGang() {
            if (selectedCard) {
                ws.send(JSON.stringify({
                    type: 'gang',
                    cardId: selectedCard.id
                }));
            }
        }

        // 胡牌
        function declareHu() {
            ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'hu' }));
        }

        function sendChat() {

            if (text) {
                ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'chat', text }));
                input.value = '';
            }

        function handleChatKey(event) {

            const div = document.createElement('div');

            line-height: 1;
        }

        .create-table-card .text {
            color: #4CAF50;
            font-size: 16px;
            margin-top: 10px;
        }

        .create-table-card:hover {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.5), rgba(46, 125, 50, 0.5));
        }

        /* 游戏界面样式 */
        .game-container {
            display: none;
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            position: relative;
        }

        .game-table {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            position: relative;
            background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, #2d5a3d 0%, #1a472a 100%);
        }

        /* 玩家区域 */
        .player-area {
            position: absolute;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .player-area.bottom {
            bottom: 10px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            width: 80%;
        }

        .player-area.top {
            top: 10px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
        }

        .player-area.left {
            left: 10px;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
        }

        .player-area.right {
            right: 10px;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
        }

        .player-info {
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
            padding: 8px 15px;
            border-radius: 5px;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .player-info.active {
            border: 2px solid #FFD700;
            box-shadow: 0 0 10px #FFD700;
        }

        .player-name {
            font-weight: bold;
        }

        .hand-count {
            font-size: 0.9em;
            color: #ccc;
        }

        /* 展示区 */
        .showed-area {
            display: flex;
            gap: 5px;
            margin: 5px 0;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .showed-card {
            width: 30px;
            height: 40px;
            background: #fff;
            border-radius: 3px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: #333;
        }

        .showed-card.fa {
            background: #FFD700;
        }

        .showed-card.gang {
            background: #90EE90;
        }

        /* 手牌区域 */
        .hand-area {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 2px;
            padding: 12px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,60,0,0.9) 0%, rgba(0,40,0,0.95) 100%);
            border-radius: 12px;
            max-width: 100%;
            box-shadow: inset 0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
        }

        /* 麻将牌基础样式 - 更真实的3D效果 */
        .card {
            width: 36px;
            height: 50px;
            background: linear-gradient(165deg, #FFFFF8 0%, #F8F4E8 20%, #EDE8D8 60%, #D8D0C0 100%);
            border-radius: 3px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.12s ease;
            position: relative;
            box-shadow:
                /* 侧边厚度 */
                1px 0 0 #B8A898,
                /* 底部厚度层叠 */
                0 2px 0 #A89888,
                0 3px 0 #988878,
                0 4px 0 #887868,
                /* 底部阴影 */
                0 5px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.35),
                /* 顶部高光 */
                inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.95),
                /* 内部纹理 */
                inset 0 -2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
            border: 1px solid #C8B8A8;
            /* 麻将牌纹理 */
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.1) 50%, transparent 100%),
                linear-gradient(165deg, #FFFFF8 0%, #F8F4E8 20%, #EDE8D8 60%, #D8D0C0 100%);
        }

        .card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-6px) scale(1.04);
            box-shadow:
                1px 0 0 #B8A898,
                0 3px 0 #A89888,
                0 5px 0 #988878,
                0 7px 0 #887868,
                0 9px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.45),
                inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.95),
                inset 0 -2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
            z-index: 10;
        }

        .card.selected {
            transform: translateY(-14px) scale(1.06);
            box-shadow:
                1px 0 0 #B8A898,
                0 4px 0 #A89888,
                0 7px 0 #988878,
                0 10px 0 #887868,
                0 13px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.5),
                inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.95),
                inset 0 -2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
            z-index: 20;
        }

        .card.dragging {
            opacity: 0.6;
            transform: scale(1.1);
        }

        .card.drag-over {
            border-left: 3px solid #FFD700;
        }

        /* 万能牌样式 - 癞子 */
        .card.wild {
            background: linear-gradient(165deg, #FFFDE7 0%, #FFF8E1 30%, #FFECB3 70%, #FFE082 100%);
            border: 2px solid #FFB300;
            box-shadow:
                1px 0 0 #FF8F00,
                0 2px 0 #F57C00,
                0 3px 0 #EF6C00,
                0 4px 0 #E65100,
                0 5px 4px rgba(255,152,0,0.5),
                inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.95),
                0 0 12px rgba(255,193,7,0.6);
        }

        /* 癞子标记 */
        .card.wild::before {
            content: '癞';
            position: absolute;
            top: -1px;
            right: -1px;
            width: 14px;
            height: 14px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FF5722 0%, #E64A19 100%);
            color: white;
            font-size: 9px;
            font-weight: bold;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            border-radius: 0 3px 0 4px;
            box-shadow: -1px 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
            z-index: 5;
        }

        /* 牌面内容容器 */
        .card-face {
            width: 30px;
            height: 42px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFFEFA 0%, #FAF8F0 100%);
            border-radius: 2px;
            box-shadow: inset 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
            border: 1px solid rgba(200,190,180,0.5);
        }

        /* 筒子牌 - 圆点图案 */
        .card.tong .card-face {
            position: relative;
        }

        .card.tong .dot-container {
            width: 26px;
            height: 34px;
            display: grid;
            place-items: center;
        }

        .card.tong .dot {
            width: 7px;
            height: 7px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #64B5F6, #1976D2 60%, #0D47A1);
            border-radius: 50%;
            box-shadow:
                inset 0 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.6),
                inset 0 -1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3),
                0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
        }

        /* 1筒 - 大圆 */
        .card.tong.p1 .dot-container {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }
        .card.tong.p1 .dot {
            width: 14px;
            height: 14px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #64B5F6, #1976D2 50%, #0D47A1);
            box-shadow:
                inset 0 2px 3px rgba(255,255,255,0.6),
                inset 0 -2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.3),
                0 2px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
        }

        /* 2筒 */
        .card.tong.p2 .dot-container {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 6px;
        }

        /* 3筒 */
        .card.tong.p3 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 2px;
        }
        .card.tong.p3 .dot:nth-child(1) { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
        .card.tong.p3 .dot:nth-child(2) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; }
        .card.tong.p3 .dot:nth-child(3) { grid-column: 1 / 3; grid-row: 2; justify-self: center; }

        /* 4筒 */
        .card.tong.p4 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 5px;
            padding: 3px;
        }

        /* 5筒 */
        .card.tong.p5 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 1px;
        }
        .card.tong.p5 .dot:nth-child(1) { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
        .card.tong.p5 .dot:nth-child(2) { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 1; }
        .card.tong.p5 .dot:nth-child(3) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; width: 9px; height: 9px; }
        .card.tong.p5 .dot:nth-child(4) { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 3; }
        .card.tong.p5 .dot:nth-child(5) { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 3; }

        /* 6筒 */
        .card.tong.p6 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 2px;
        }

        /* 7筒 */
        .card.tong.p7 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 1px;
        }
        .card.tong.p7 .dot:nth-child(1) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; }
        .card.tong.p7 .dot:nth-child(2) { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 2; }
        .card.tong.p7 .dot:nth-child(3) { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 2; }
        .card.tong.p7 .dot:nth-child(4) { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 3; }
        .card.tong.p7 .dot:nth-child(5) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 3; }
        .card.tong.p7 .dot:nth-child(6) { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 3; }
        .card.tong.p7 .dot:nth-child(7) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; width: 9px; height: 9px; }

        /* 8筒 */
        .card.tong.p8 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 2px;
        }
        .card.tong.p8 .dot:nth-child(4) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; display: none; }
        .card.tong.p8 .dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; }

        /* 9筒 */
        .card.tong.p9 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 2px;
        }
        .card.tong.p9 .dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; }

        /* 条子牌 - 竹节图案 */
        .card.tiao .card-face {
            padding: 2px;
        }
        .card.tiao .bamboo-container {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 1px;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .card.tiao .bamboo-stick {
            width: 5px;
            height: 7px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #1B5E20, #2E7D32 30%, #4CAF50 50%, #2E7D32 70%, #1B5E20);
            border-radius: 1px;
            box-shadow:
                inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.4),
                inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.2),
                0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
        }
        .card.tiao .bamboo-stick.short { height: 5px; }
        .card.tiao .bamboo-row {
            display: flex;
            gap: 2px;
        }

        /* 万子牌 */
        .card.wan .card-face {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 0px;
        }
        .card.wan .wan-num {
            font-size: 15px;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #B71C1C;
            line-height: 1;
            font-family: 'KaiTi', 'STKaiti', 'SimSun', serif;
            text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
        }
        .card.wan .wan-char {
            font-size: 11px;
            color: #B71C1C;
            font-weight: bold;
            font-family: 'KaiTi', 'STKaiti', 'SimSun', serif;
            text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
        }

        /* 风牌 */
        .card.feng .card-face {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }
        .card.feng .feng-char {
            font-size: 20px;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #0D47A1;
            font-family: 'KaiTi', 'STKaiti', 'SimSun', serif;
            text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.5), 1px 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
        }

        /* 箭牌 */
        .card.jian .card-face {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }
        .card.jian .jian-char {
            font-size: 20px;
            font-weight: bold;
            font-family: 'KaiTi', 'STKaiti', 'SimSun', serif;
        }

        .card.jian.zhong .jian-char {
            color: #C62828;
            text-shadow: 0 0 2px rgba(198,40,40,0.4), 1px 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
        }
        .card.jian.fa .jian-char {
            color: #1B5E20;
            text-shadow: 0 0 2px rgba(46,125,50,0.4), 1px 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
        }
        .card.jian.bai .jian-char {
            color: #37474F;
            text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 #78909C, -1px -1px 0 #fff;
        }

        /* 兼容旧样式（用于其他区域显示） */
        .card-rank {
            font-size: 15px;
            font-weight: bold;
        }
        .card-suit {
            font-size: 9px;
            color: #666;
        }

        /* 中央信息区 */
        .center-info {
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            text-align: center;
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
            padding: 20px;
            border-radius: 10px;
        }

        .wild-card-info {
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }

        .wild-card-info .label {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: #ccc;
        }

        .wild-card-info .card-display {
            font-size: 24px;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #FFD700;
        }

        .deck-count {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: #ccc;
        }

        .game-time {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: #FFD700;
            margin-top: 5px;
        }

        /* 操作按钮 */
        .action-buttons {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            justify-content: center;
            margin-top: 10px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .action-btn {
            padding: 8px 20px;
            font-size: 14px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 5px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .action-btn:disabled {
            opacity: 0.5;
            cursor: not-allowed;
        }

        .action-btn.play {
            background: #4CAF50;
            color: white;
        }

        .action-btn.fa {
            background: #FFD700;
            color: #333;
        }

        .action-btn.gang {
            background: #9C27B0;
            color: white;
        }

        .action-btn.hu {
            background: #f44336;
            color: white;
        }

        /* 聊天区域 */
        .chat-area {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 200px;
            right: 10px;
            width: 200px;
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 10px;
        }

        .chat-messages {
            height: 150px;
            overflow-y: auto;
            font-size: 12px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .chat-input {
            display: flex;
            gap: 5px;
        }

        .chat-input input {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 5px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 3px;
        }

        /* 准备界面 */
        .ready-panel {
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
            padding: 30px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            text-align: center;
            z-index: 100;
        }

        .ready-panel h2 {
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .seat-list {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .seat-item {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            padding: 10px;
            border-radius: 5px;
        }

        .seat-item.occupied {
            background: rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.3);
        }

        .seat-item.me {
            border: 2px solid #FFD700;
        }

        /* 玩家列表面板 */
        .players-panel {
            position: absolute;
            top: 10px;
            left: 10px;
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
            padding: 15px;
            border-radius: 10px;
        }

        .players-panel h3 {
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .player-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            padding: 5px 0;
            font-size: 13px;
        }

        .player-item .seat {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
            padding: 2px 8px;
            border-radius: 3px;
            font-size: 12px;
        }

        .player-item .ready-status {
            color: #4CAF50;
            font-size: 12px;
        }

        .player-item .not-ready {
            color: #999;
        }

        /* 隐藏 */
        .hidden {
            display: none !important;
        }

        /* 当前玩家指示 */
        .current-turn {
            color: #FFD700 !important;
            font-weight: bold;
        }

        .current-turn::before {
            content: '▶ ';
            color: #FFD700;
        }

        /* 发牌动画 */
        .deal-animation {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            z-index: 1000;
        }

        .deal-piles {
            display: flex;
            gap: 20px;
            margin-bottom: 30px;
        }

        .deal-pile {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .deal-pile-label {
            color: #fff;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .deal-pile-cards {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            width: 120px;
            gap: 2px;
        }

        .deal-card-back {
            width: 25px;
            height: 35px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a237e 0%, #283593 100%);
            border-radius: 3px;
            border: 1px solid #3949ab;
        }

        .deal-info {
            color: #FFD700;
            font-size: 24px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .deal-progress {
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 16px;
        }
